items.title: グッチが新作バッグ「ジャッキー フラップ」発売
items.summary: Gucci released the Jackie Flap men's bag from its Fall/Winter 2026 'Gucci Primavera' collection, drawing on the heritage Jackie bag's piston closure, with 2-way shoulder/crossbody function. Two versions: canvas with 3D GG pattern (JPY 473,000) and handcrafted leather (JPY 539,000). Straight product-launch write-up with no independent evaluative verdict -- activation_coverage.

items.title: ハリウッドセレブに愛用者が多い〈グッチ〉の新作メンズバッグ ジャッキー フラップに注目！
items.summary: Follow-up coverage of the Gucci Jackie Flap noting celebrity adoption, citing Shawn Mendes photographed wearing the black leather version in Rio de Janeiro paired with web-stripe denim. Frames the bag as blending 'classical codes with contemporary sensibility.' Descriptive celebrity-spotting piece -- activation_coverage, no independent critical judgment.

items.title: BTS 진 x 구찌(Gucci) 화보 풀렸는데 진짜 미쳤다는 말밖에 안 나옴
items.summary: Korean fan SNS post reacting enthusiastically to BTS Jin's Gucci ambassador photoshoot/video (released alongside an August 19 Harper's Bazaar video), praising his suiting and presence as overshadowing the brand itself. Genuine fan-driven organic reaction rather than brand-sourced copy, but falls under the ambassador/fandom trap -- magnitude should be damped per sentiment rubric. Engagement counts (likes/replies) not visible on the fetched page.

items.title: Luxury's reset year: Kering steadies as China recalibrates
items.summary: Trade-press analysis on Kering/Gucci positioning as China's luxury market recalibrates; subtitle frames it as 'stability returns, confidence does not,' describing Gucci's turnaround as strategic repositioning rather than straightforward growth. Independent trade-press evaluative framing, not brand-sourced. STALE beyond the 72h target and near the edge of usefulness -- retained only because no fresher independent China-market analytical piece surfaced despite repeated targeted searches today; treat as low-weight context, not a fresh signal.

items.title: 중고명품 리셀은... 매입처가 진짜 문제 아닐까요?
items.summary: Korean secondhand-luxury reseller community post arguing the 'luxury resale isn't profitable anymore' narrative -- which explicitly names Gucci among affected brands in the broader Korean resale-market downturn -- stems from wholesale-sourcing margin problems rather than pure demand collapse. Independent trade-community commentary reflecting continued erosion of confidence in the Gucci resale channel; engagement counts not visible on the fetched page.

items.title: 중고시장 뜨는데 중고 명품은 외면…신뢰 잃은 '럭셔리 리셀'의 추락
items.summary: Korean media report: general secondhand fashion trading is booming while dedicated luxury-resale platforms contract, hurt by inflated pricing, counterfeit concerns and eroding brand trust; cites falling global resale premiums as part of a broader luxury-resale value decline affecting brands including Gucci. Independent critical market-structure signal corroborating the resale-market skepticism theme; kept just past the ideal window as the most substantive recent Korean resale-critical piece available. Near the edge of the 14-day ceiling -- replace with fresher coverage next cycle if available.

items.title: 구찌, 신세계 강남 '구찌 에디터룸' 7월 30일 오픈…익스클루시브 컬렉션 공개
items.summary: Gucci ran a pop-up 'Gucci Editor Room' at Shinsegae Department Store Gangnam (The Stage, 1F) July 30-August 9, showing womenswear, menswear, Jackie/Borsetto/Paparazzo handbags plus pop-up-exclusive items. Retail-activation announcement -- activation_coverage. Carried forward as the most recent NEA retail-presence signal; no fresher Korean retail item surfaced today.
